name: Integrate and review the bosses fix

nodes.name: Integrate and render bosses
nodes.prompt: Integrate the bosses fix (D {{wD.summary}} / L {{wL.summary}} / U {{wU.summary}}). Read the contract section '## Bosses fix (2026-11-20)' and its 'Bosses fix: follow-ups from the reviews' list: fix every code item there (Sneed level/model from lootNpcIDs, Gahz'rilla and Barthilas portrait files, the Wowhead retry sleep). Run the FULL suite (loop over tests/test_*.py with /tmp/qs-test-env/bin/python) until green; all QuestSharing/*.lua compile under Lua 5.1 (lupa.lua51 loadstring). Update tools/render_journal.py: bosses scene from the real DungeonBossData list for The Deadmines, plus a new scene 'bosses_forever' (The Hall of Thanes, no AtlasLoot); re-render, repaint, update context/renders/index.html. One CHANGELOG Unreleased line. Report {files, summary, tests}.

nodes.name: Review the bosses fix
nodes.prompt: Final review of the bosses fix ({{integ.summary}}). Does it fix the user complaint: only real bosses (check several dungeons against /tmp/ejdata/f_DungeonEncounter.csv), every boss has a portrait icon, calm formatting (look at context/renders/bosses*.png vs /tmp/dj_images/dj3.png)?
